_comment: Files under workflow-templates/.claude/ whose live .claude/ copy in coding-workflows is maintained separately on purpose. Every other template file with a live copy must match it byte for byte (tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py), and .github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml copies a template change to the live copy when a push to main changed only the template (scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py).

divergent.commands/analyze-log.md: live copy carries coding-workflows-specific steps; both copies are edited together
divergent.commands/deploy-activate.md: live copy carries coding-workflows-specific steps; both copies are edited together
divergent.commands/implement-issue-claude.md: live copy describes this repo's cut-over engine; the template describes consumers before their stable sync
divergent.commands/investigate-issue.md: live copy carries coding-workflows-specific steps; both copies are edited together
divergent.commands/validate-consumer-issue.md: live copy carries coding-workflows-specific steps; both copies are edited together
divergent.commands/verify-activation.md: live copy carries coding-workflows-specific steps; both copies are edited together
divergent.settings.json: live copy also allows the claude-code-remote session-opening tool without the Auto-mode check, for the daily activation routine that runs in a coding-workflows session (operator decision 2026-10-26); consumers do not get it. Every other change must be made in both copies by hand, because the live-copy sync and parity test skip this file now
